adobe-enhance-speech: Adobe AI tool (Adobe Podcast) that cleans up and enhances recorded speech, removing noise and reverb.
adobe-fresco: Adobe's digital drawing app (vector and raster) with live brushes, for illustration on tablet and desktop.
adobe-stock: Licensed asset library (photos, videos, vectors, templates) integrated with the Creative Cloud apps.
ashby: Modern applicant tracking system (ATS) for startups and scale-ups, focused on analytics, structured interviewing and deep reporting.
attio: Modern, data-oriented CRM with a flexible data model, email/calendar sync and automations, built for go-to-market teams.
axonaut: French all-in-one ERP for small businesses: CRM, compliant invoicing, accounting, cash flow, projects, expenses and stock in one platform.
brand-kits: Brand identity platform (Stylebase) to define, evolve and share brand guidelines and design systems.
captain-contrat: French legaltech for legal guidance: company formation, contract drafting and legal support, on a hybrid tech + lawyers model.
causal: FP&A and financial modelling platform: build models, connect live data and share interactive dashboards, a structured alternative to spreadsheets.
coupler-io: No-code data integration platform that automates data flows from 400+ apps into spreadsheets, BI tools, warehouses and AI tools.
creatoriq: Enterprise creator/influencer marketing platform: creator discovery, campaign management, relationship workflows, analytics and reporting.
customer-io: Multichannel marketing automation platform (email, push, in-app, SMS, webhooks) driven by first-party data, with segmentation and a visual workflow builder.
dovetail-ai: Qualitative research platform: store interview transcripts, tag and code data, surface cross-project themes and share insights.
feedly: RSS reader and monitoring tool that aggregates sources, blogs and news in one place, with AI Feeds to filter and prioritise information.
float: Resource management software for delivery teams: plan who works on what, capacity, availability and time tracking.
gamma-ai: AI platform to create presentations, documents and web pages in minutes from a prompt, with automatic formatting.
gocardless: Recurring bank-debit payments platform (Direct Debit, SEPA, ACH) built for subscription billing — a bank-based alternative to card payments.
gong: Revenue intelligence platform that records, transcribes and AI-analyses sales calls to surface deal risk, coaching and pipeline insights.
instantly: B2B cold email software for high-volume outbound with multiple sending accounts, inbox warmup, campaigns and deliverability tracking.
kling: AI video generator (text-to-video and image-to-video) by Kuaishou: high-motion clips, physics simulation, character consistency, native 4K and a developer API.
legalplace: French legaltech specialised in online company formation and legal procedures: articles, changes, dissolution, business address, accounting and everyday legal documents.
lightroom-mobile: Mobile version of Adobe Lightroom: non-destructive photo editing, presets and cloud sync, part of the Creative Cloud ecosystem.
lindy: No-code AI agent platform that automates email, meetings and workflows across 100+ integrations (email triage, meeting notes, CRM updates, multi-step workflows).
magnific: AI image upscaler and enhancer that enlarges up to 16x while inventing realistic detail, with a Creativity slider. Now part of Freepik.
mojo: Mobile app to create animated stories and reels for social networks (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) with templates, text styles, stickers and video effects.
moobot: Cloud chatbot for Twitch: automates chat moderation, scheduled messages, custom commands, polls, giveaways and song requests. No download.
openai: Maker of ChatGPT and the GPT models: a conversational AI assistant (web, apps, API) for writing, code, analysis and automation, with a range of models and a developer API.
power-user: Productivity add-in for PowerPoint, Excel and Word: thousands of templates, vector icons, editable maps and diagrams (Gantt, Mekko, waterfall) and HD images.
productive-io: All-in-one agency management tool: project management, resource planning, budgets, invoicing and reporting in one platform, with AI features and integrations.
readwise: Read-later and retention tool: centralises articles, PDFs, newsletters, RSS and highlights, with daily review and export to Notion/Obsidian. Includes the Reader app.
relevance-ai: No-code platform to build and orchestrate teams of AI agents ('AI Workforce'): automates research, outbound, data enrichment and back-office tasks for GTM and ops teams.
relume-ai: AI-assisted design framework: generates sitemaps and wireframes from a 1,000+ component library, exportable to Webflow, Figma or React.
storyluxe: Mobile app to create social stories: 700+ photo/video templates (film, paper, collage, neon), vintage film filters, designer fonts and backdrops.
supermetrics: Marketing data integration platform that automatically extracts and moves data from 150+ channels (Google Ads, Meta, Shopify) into Sheets, Excel, Looker Studio or a warehouse.
teleprompter: Teleprompter app (iPhone, iPad, macOS): read scripts, speeches and lyrics with auto or voice-driven scrolling, mirroring, speed control and built-in video recording.
tezza: Photo and video editing app (iOS/Android) for creators, focused on film-inspired aesthetics: presets, video effects, story templates, collages, feed planner and batch editing.
topaz: Maker of Topaz Labs' AI enhancement software: Photo AI (denoise, sharpen), Video AI (video enhancement) and Gigapixel (upscaling up to 6x, runs locally on your GPU).
weezevent: Ticketing and event platform: online ticketing, cashless, access control, staff accreditation and CRM for trade shows, concerts, festivals and conferences.
learnworlds: Platform to create, host and sell online courses: a white-label training school with sales pages, interactive video and certifications.
teachable: Platform to create and sell online courses, coaching and digital products, with built-in sales pages and payments.
teamwork: Project management software for agencies and client-service teams: time tracking, invoicing, per-project profitability and multiple views (lists, boards, Gantt).
wrike: Project management and collaborative work software for teams and enterprises: tasks, multiple views (Kanban, Gantt, tables), automations and reporting.
tiktok: Short-form video platform driven by a discovery algorithm: create, edit in-app (sounds, effects, captions) and publish, with strong organic-reach potential. Business side via TikTok for Business / TikTok Ads.
